Handy Features

Create it, import it, reuse it.

Create tasks, bulk-register via CSV, or reuse templates — all freely. No more starting from scratch every single time.

📝

Create Task

Create a new task by specifying project, issue type, assignee, milestone, and parent issue

📥

Bulk CSV Registration

Register multiple tasks at once from a CSV. Template CSV download included

📤

CSV Export

Exports the current list as UTF-8 with BOM. Reference columns and bulk-registration columns in a single file

💬

Comment Templates

Save your go-to replies and post them instantly, mentions included

🔖

Filter Presets

Save your filter, search, and grouping settings under a name and recall them anytime

📌

Pin

Pin important tasks to the top, and they're automatically added to your Backlog watch list too

Cut task registration down to almost nothing.

Backlog My Tasks

A Chrome extension that lets you check and manage your assigned Backlog tasks across multiple spaces in one place. 8 views and a project dashboard make daily task management and team progress tracking easier.
